headline: Navigating Entry and Activities at Lake Mead
reservation: Lake Mead National Recreation Area requires an entry fee or a valid federal lands pass, payable at park gates. While most campgrounds are first-come, first-served, developed RV sites with hookups at Callville Bay or Echo Bay require reservations through private concessionaires. Check the official NPS site for current water levels as they may impact boat ramp availability.

days.title: Railroads and Massive Dams

stops.name: Historic Railroad Trail
stops.detail: Hike through five massive tunnels used during the construction of the dam with views of Boulder Basin.

stops.name: Hoover Dam
stops.detail: View this engineering icon from the O'Callaghan-Tillman Bridge or walk the dam crest.

days.driving: Allow 20 minutes for local transfers; conditions vary
days.note: Hike the railroad trail in the early morning to avoid the unshaded Mojave sun.

days.title: Volcanic Cliffs and Emerald Waters

stops.name: Black Canyon
stops.detail: Paddle the Colorado River between towering volcanic walls to discover hidden hot springs.

stops.name: Emerald Cove
stops.detail: Witness the green-hued waters in this narrow cavern, accessible by kayak or small boat.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes to Willow Beach from Boulder City; conditions vary
days.note: Black Canyon kayak launches below the dam require a pre-arranged outfitter permit.

days.title: Redstone and Desert Vistas

stops.name: Redstone Picnic Area
stops.detail: Walk among ancient, twisted red sandstone outcrops and petrified dunes.

stops.name: Bowl of Fire
stops.detail: Explore a secluded region of fiery red rock formations away from the main lake hubs.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for the scenic Northshore drive; conditions vary
days.note: Northshore Road is remote with no services; ensure your vehicle is prepared for the desert traverse.

intel.title: Hemenway and Beach Lots
intel.text: Parking at popular spots like Boulder Beach fills early on weekends. Use the Alan Bible Visitor Center for orientation if primary trailhead lots are at capacity.

intel.title: Remote Canyons
intel.text: Expect total loss of cellular signal along large stretches of Northshore Road and within the Black Canyon. Carry a physical map and tell someone your itinerary.

intel.title: Mojave Range
intel.text: Fuel is available in Boulder City and at major marinas like Callville Bay. Do not start the Northshore Road drive without a full tank, as stations are non-existent on the loop.

intel.title: Summer Heat Safety
intel.text: Hiking is strongly discouraged after 10 AM from June through September. Plan all strenuous land activity for the winter or shoulder months.

intel.title: Water Level Impact
intel.text: Dropping water levels can result in the closure of specific boat ramps like Echo Bay. Verify the current launch status on the NPS 'Current Conditions' page before towing a craft.

plan.arrival: Pick up rental in Las Vegas or Henderson; stock up on water and supplies in Boulder City before entering the park boundary.
plan.vehicle: RV travel is popular at developed campgrounds, but check for length restrictions on specific winding roads near the Black Canyon overlooks.
plan.goldenHour: Sunset View Overlook provides a named location for watching the light change over the desert mountains, depending on the season.
